Occupations at Risk 87
E. Suppose you were with Sohan. Ask the bedey woman some more questions.
For example, you can ask questions to know about her family members,
their names, age, work, their past living places, future plans, food habit, etc:
F, Have you ever seen any gypsies/bedey/snake charmers or any person
selling things from door to door in your area? Write your experience about
any one of them:
